_purpose: Single source of truth for whether the LOCAL harness can grade a DeepSWE task. Read by scripts/verify/deepswe_outcome.py (ungradeable_reason_for). A task in known_ungradeable is classified UNGRADEABLE (excluded from the resolved denominator, never a regression) UNLESS a cached verified_gradeable gold->1 entry clears it. Fail-OPEN: a task absent from BOTH maps is assumed gradeable (this file lists exceptions + proofs only, not all 113 tasks).
_rules: known_ungradeable: the GOLD solution itself scores reward 0 on the local harness (grader broken here, not the agent). Requires evidence: a gold-patch grading run producing reward 0 with n_err 0.
verified_gradeable: a cached gold->1 proof (the gold patch scored reward 1 locally). Clears a known_ungradeable entry and lets the task's real outcomes count.
Never guess. An entry without evidence is not admissible. 'Assumed gradeable' is the DEFAULT (absence), not a claim.

On the box the heavy suites exceed jest's 30s hook timeout -> suites fail -> reward 0 EVEN ON THE GOLD SOLUTION (GT-off, no agent: New tests exit 0, Baseline exit 1 = 36 hook timeouts, FINAL_REWARD 0). tmpfs (mongo on RAM) is the only lever (36->7 timeouts) and the residual is irreducible single-thread mongo/app-boot speed vs datacurve's Modal. Box-env-blocked; datacurve Modal grades it 4/4. Evidence: parity session 2026-07-07 gold-grade run.
